title: Save Your Money And Use Vinegar!
text: Save Your Money And Use Vinegar!. Easy to use but does not really clean much.  I cannot even notice that I used the cleaner.  Expensive.  Just use vinegar in the water tank, run two empty coffee cycles and turn power off.  Leave for about 30 minutes, turn back on and run the empty coffee cycles until the low water warning.  Rise out water tank and fill with clean water.  Then run empty coffee cycles thru until the water tank is empty.  Cleaning should be done and you saved money!
